title: Fixed Versus Variable Break-Even Calculator
creator: Katie Jo Schuman
subject: AI economics
description: The learner will calculate the monthly request volume at which a fixed-cost server and a per-request API cost the same, to within 1,000 requests.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the monthly request volume at which a fixed-cost server and a per-request API cost the same, to within 1,000 requests.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit-then-explore: predict, receive feedback, then explore
commonMisconceptions: (1) Break-even depends on the benefits only. (2) The break-even volume does not change when the fixed cost changes. (3) The fixed-cost option is always cheaper at high volume, regardless of its capacity.
assessmentOpportunities: For each of three scenarios the learner types the break-even volume before the chart reveals it. An answer is correct when within 1,000 requests of the model value. Mastery is 3 of 3 correct on the first attempt. Dragging the volume marker is exploration, not evidence.
